A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ToCa research. All 22 pages of each version, including figures, tables, equations and appendices, are readable and support a complete comparison.

before.justification: V3 reports original ToCa image- and video-generation experiments, including benchmark comparisons, ablations, sensitivity studies and FLUX evaluations in the appendix.

after.justification: V4 retains original ToCa results on PixArt-alpha, OpenSora, DiT and FLUX, together with the ablations and supplementary analyses.

M1.justification: The caching procedure, four token-selection scores, layer-dependent ratios, appendix scheduling techniques and Algorithm 1 are unchanged. The new Section 3 overview summarizes existing components.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same image- and video-generation coverage using COCO2017, PartiPrompts, ImageNet and VBench. The higher-resolution FLUX evaluations already appear in v3 Appendix A.6.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged across Tables 1–7. The newly cited token-pruning works are not evaluated as baselines; T-GATE's citation changes from Zhang et al., 2024 to 2024b only.

E3.justification: Reported datasets, sampling procedures, metrics, model configurations and sampling-step counts remain unchanged in Section 4.1 and the appendices. The revised Table 3 FLOPs are not accompanied by a reported protocol change.

E4.justification: Tables 4–5 retain the same component ablations. The token-error analyses, cache-frequency visualization, Appendix A.3 sensitivity study and supplementary case studies are also unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions report five differently seeded videos per VBench prompt and retain the same distribution-analysis sampling information. No repeated-run counts, uncertainty estimates or statistical reporting practices change.

E6.justification: Table 3 revises FLOPs(T): DiT 59.36 to 118.68; 33% steps 19.71 to 39.40; 37% steps 22.08 to 44.15; FORA N=3 20.02 to 39.95; FORA N=2.8 21.68 to 43.36; ToCa 21.61 to 43.22. This localized cost revision leaves latency, speedup, generation-quality scores and all other reported results unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, Equations (1)–(6), appendix scheduling formulas and computational-complexity derivations are retained. The added methodology overview introduces no new formal reasoning.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions and conclusion retain the same claims about training-free token-wise caching, error propagation and acceleration with nearly preserved generation quality.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning temporal redundancy, error propagation, semantic consistency and excessive caching remain unchanged. The new overview restates the existing accumulated-error motivation without adding a substantive mechanism or limitation.

D1.justification: The FLUX reference replaces its Hugging Face FLUX.1-dev model-page link with the Black Forest Labs FLUX GitHub repository, changing the supplied resource pointer. ToCa's code link and the implementation, hardware and hyperparameter disclosures remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds two token-pruning references by Evelyn Zhang et al. (2024a and 2025). This modestly extends related-work coverage without changing the paper's substantive positioning against previous caching methods.

P1.justification: V4 adds a short Section 3 roadmap summarizing the four token scores, separates related-work paragraph headings, updates an affiliation and replaces the preprint header with the ICLR 2025 publication header. Most prose and the section sequence are retained.

P2.justification: Figure 5 moves from page 7 to page 6, and surrounding figures, tables and text are repositioned through reflow and spacing changes. No figure or table is added or removed; graphical content and table structures are retained.

improvement.justification: The methodology overview improves orientation, and the added references modestly broaden context. Table 3's revised 250-step DiT baseline cost of 118.68 T also aligns with five times the unchanged 50-step cost of 23.74 T in Table 6, improving internal consistency. The FLOP revision remains unexplained, and the underlying method and experimental evidence are unchanged, so the overall gain is limited.
